label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebration/surprise for the mayor: 200 fresh loaves on the town hall great hall feast tables and eight lanterns, with the neighbour arranging to escort the mayor there. Baker and freight coordinated bread; innkeeper baked and organized supplies; builder installed lanterns and transported bread; neighbour helped carry bread and arrange the mayor's discreet arrival. The mayor was not told of the surprise, though later rumor and the mayor's arrival at the hall are recorded.
